title: The Cell That Ignores the World Moving

scenes.tts: How could one cell tell a moving object from a moving world?
scenes.visual: Title card: The Cell That Ignores the World Moving. A small dark shape on a still sky beside a whole landscape sliding sideways. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: How could one cell tell a moving object from a moving world?

scenes.tts: In twenty twelve, Zhang and colleagues recorded from W three cells in isolated mouse retina.
scenes.caption: In 2012, Zhang and colleagues recorded from W3 cells in isolated mouse retina.
scenes.visual: A flat piece of mouse retina in a dish, a recording electrode touching one cell. Label: Zhang and colleagues, 2012; W3 cells, isolated mouse retina.
scenes.narration: In 2012, Zhang and colleagues recorded from W3 cells in isolated mouse retina.

scenes.tts: Start with a spot. Brighten a small spot over the cell, and it fires.
scenes.visual: A small spot over the cell brightens; spike ticks appear on a raster line below. Label: schematic.
scenes.narration: Start with a spot. Brighten a small spot over the cell, and it fires.

scenes.tts: Dim the same spot, and it fires again.
scenes.visual: The same spot dims; another burst of spike ticks appears.
scenes.narration: Dim the same spot, and it fires again.

scenes.tts: The cell takes excitation from the on pathway, driven when light goes up, and from the off pathway.
scenes.caption: The cell takes excitation from the ON pathway, driven when light goes up, and from the OFF pathway.
scenes.visual: Two input arrows labelled ON (light goes up) and OFF (light goes down) converge on the W3 cell.
scenes.narration: The cell takes excitation from the ON pathway, driven when light goes up, and from the OFF pathway.

scenes.tts: So a change of either sign excites it. The two inputs add rather than cancel.
scenes.visual: Text on screen: either sign of local change excites W3. Small label: ON and OFF inputs add, not cancel.
scenes.narration: So a change of either sign excites it. The two inputs add rather than cancel.

scenes.tts: Now motion. A small textured patch moves over the cell's centre, and the background stays still. The distant surround is a wide ring far outside the centre.
scenes.visual: The cell's centre drawn as an inner circle and the distant surround as a wide ring. A textured patch moves in the centre; the surround is still.
scenes.narration: Now motion. A small textured patch moves over the cell's centre, and the background stays still. The distant surround is a wide ring far outside the centre.

scenes.tts: The cell fires many spikes. Say forty.
scenes.caption: The cell fires many spikes. Say 40.
scenes.visual: The raster fills with ticks. Counter: about 40 spikes (illustrative, schematic).
scenes.narration: The cell fires many spikes. Say 40.

scenes.tts: Now the whole scene moves together. The centre gets exactly the same stimulus.
scenes.visual: The same patch moves in the centre, and now the surround texture moves with it. Label: centre stimulus unchanged.
scenes.narration: Now the whole scene moves together. The centre gets exactly the same stimulus.

scenes.tts: Predict. If the cell listened only to its centre, what would it do now?
scenes.visual: Pause card: whole scene moves. Predict. An empty raster line waits.
scenes.narration: Predict. If the cell listened only to its centre, what would it do now?

scenes.tts: It would fire just as much. It does not. It falls nearly silent. Say three spikes.
scenes.caption: It would fire just as much. It does not. It falls nearly silent. Say 3 spikes.
scenes.visual: The raster stays nearly empty. Counter: about 3 spikes (illustrative, schematic).
scenes.narration: It would fire just as much. It does not. It falls nearly silent. Say 3 spikes.

scenes.tts: So motion far out in the surround must be silencing it.
scenes.visual: The surround ring pulses; an arrow points from it toward the cell.
scenes.narration: So motion far out in the surround must be silencing it.

scenes.tts: Zhang and colleagues found that this happens in two places at once.
scenes.visual: Two target markers appear: one on the inputs bringing excitation, one on the W3 cell itself.
scenes.narration: Zhang and colleagues found that this happens in two places at once.

scenes.tts: Part is presynaptic. The excitation is suppressed before it reaches the cell, so less of it arrives.
scenes.visual: The excitatory input arrows thin out before they reach the cell. Label: presynaptic suppression.
scenes.narration: Part is presynaptic. The excitation is suppressed before it reaches the cell, so less of it arrives.

scenes.tts: Part is postsynaptic. Inhibition lands on the W three cell itself.
scenes.caption: Part is postsynaptic. Inhibition lands on the W3 cell itself.
scenes.visual: Inhibitory marks land on the W3 cell body and dendrites. Label: postsynaptic inhibition.
scenes.narration: Part is postsynaptic. Inhibition lands on the W3 cell itself.

scenes.tts: Older work on similar cells in other species proposed wide-field amacrine cells as the source of this kind of suppression.
scenes.visual: A wide-field amacrine cell with processes spreading far across the retina, reaching from the surround toward the centre. Label: proposed source, from work in other species.
scenes.narration: Older work on similar cells in other species proposed wide-field amacrine cells as the source of this kind of suppression.

scenes.tts: Where does the excitation come from? Much of it does not come straight from bipolar cells.
scenes.visual: Bipolar cells drawn above the W3 cell, with a dashed direct link.
scenes.narration: Where does the excitation come from? Much of it does not come straight from bipolar cells.

scenes.tts: It arrives through the V G three amacrine cell, an excitatory amacrine cell.
scenes.caption: It arrives through the VG3 amacrine cell, an excitatory amacrine cell.
scenes.visual: A VG3 amacrine cell inserted between bipolar cells and the W3 cell, relaying excitation. Label: VG3 amacrine cell (Krishnaswamy and colleagues, 2015).
scenes.narration: It arrives through the VG3 amacrine cell, an excitatory amacrine cell.

scenes.tts: So the circuit that builds the selection starts before the ganglion cell sees the signal.
scenes.visual: Highlight on the VG3 cell. Text: selection starts before the ganglion cell.
scenes.narration: So the circuit that builds the selection starts before the ganglion cell sees the signal.

scenes.tts: Two amacrine cells, two jobs. V G three brings excitation in. Wide-field cells are the proposed brake.
scenes.caption: Two amacrine cells, two jobs. VG3 brings excitation in. Wide-field cells are the proposed brake.
scenes.visual: Split card: left, the VG3 amacrine cell with an arrow into W3, labelled excitation in; right, a wide-field amacrine cell labelled proposed brake (other species).
scenes.narration: Two amacrine cells, two jobs. VG3 brings excitation in. Wide-field cells are the proposed brake.

scenes.tts: A W three cell answers one question. Is something small moving differently from everything else?
scenes.caption: A W3 cell answers one question. Is something small moving differently from everything else?
scenes.visual: Text on screen: is something small moving differently from everything else?
scenes.narration: A W3 cell answers one question. Is something small moving differently from everything else?

scenes.tts: When the eye or head turns, the whole image slides together.
scenes.visual: The whole landscape slides sideways as if the head turns; the W3 raster stays nearly empty.
scenes.narration: When the eye or head turns, the whole image slides together.

scenes.tts: The authors proposed these cells as alarm neurons for overhead predators.
scenes.visual: A small dark shape crosses a still sky; the W3 raster fills. Label: proposed alarm neuron.
scenes.narration: The authors proposed these cells as alarm neurons for overhead predators.

scenes.tts: That is a hypothesis. The experiments used isolated retina, and no behavioural test of necessity was done.
scenes.visual: Label: hypothesis. Tested in isolated retina; no behavioural test of necessity.
scenes.narration: That is a hypothesis. The experiments used isolated retina, and no behavioural test of necessity was done.

scenes.tts: A second channel is the jam B cell, an off cell. Most labelled cells had a lopsided dendritic arbor.
scenes.caption: A second channel is the JAM-B cell, an OFF cell. Most labelled cells had a lopsided dendritic arbor.
scenes.visual: An OFF ganglion cell whose dendrites extend mostly to one side of the cell body. Label: JAM-B cell (Kim and colleagues, 2008).
scenes.narration: A second channel is the JAM-B cell, an OFF cell. Most labelled cells had a lopsided dendritic arbor.

scenes.tts: These lopsided cells preferred movement from the cell body toward the dendrites.
scenes.visual: A bar sweeps from soma toward dendrites and the cell fires; sweeping the other way is less effective. Label: schematic.
scenes.narration: These lopsided cells preferred movement from the cell body toward the dendrites.

scenes.tts: The filter is built inside the retina. The scene motion this cell ignores still travels in other channels.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the filter is built inside the retina; other channels carry what W3 ignores. A W3 cell beside its VG3 input.
scenes.narration: The filter is built inside the retina. The scene motion this cell ignores still travels in other channels.
